section: OPC UA Powertrain Asset Management Specification > Overview
text: Explicit model for drive chains and rotating equipment power transmission.

section: OPC UA Powertrain Asset Management Specification > Powertrain Topology
text:
``` 
Electric Motor -> Coupling -> Gearbox -> Transmission Shaft -> Load (Pump/Compressor/Fan)
```

section: OPC UA Powertrain Asset Management Specification > Key Attributes
text:
- Rating parameters: Nominal Power (kW), Rated Speed (RPM), Torque (Nm), Gear Ratio.
- Sensor Associations: Vibration (mm/s RMS), Bearing Temperature (°C), Oil Level.
